name: list_payees
description: List the household's saved, active payees (name, category, payeeId). Use this to find who the user means.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

name: lookup_bill
description: Look up the amount due on a saved biller payee (electricity, water, mobile). Returns amount in rupees and due date.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

name: pay_saved_payee
description: Pay a saved, active payee. Amount is in rupees. Returns a receipt, or the rule that held or blocked the payment.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

name: request_approval
description: Ask the family approver to approve something Kavach cannot do alone: a new payee, a payment over the limit, or a payment after untrusted content was read.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining what the user wants.

payeeVpa.description: For new_payee: the payee's UPI ID.

payeeId.description: For over_limit or tainted: the saved payee.

amountInr.description: Amount in rupees, if a payment is involved.

name: explain_rule
description: Return a household rule in plain language and when it was set. Use it to explain why something was held or blocked.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

ruleId.description: Rule ID such as R3 or S1.

name: alert_family
description: Send an alert to the family approver, for example when the user seems to be under pressure from a caller.

sessionId.description: The current session ID, exactly as given in the system prompt.

reason.description: One plain sentence on why the approver is being alerted.
